sources.entry: Passbolt - Collaborative password manager. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/deb/K8S/Docker
Passbolt | Password manager built for team collaboration

summary.one_liner: Passbolt is an open source, self-hostable password manager built for teams to store, organize and share credentials securely.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Passbolt as a security-first password manager for teams that centralizes, organizes and shares passwords and secrets. It cites user-owned secret keys and end-to-end encryption as its security model, and says it is audited multiple times a year with findings made public. Collaboration features include sharing and auditing credentials with policies for power users. The README says it collects no personal data or telemetry and can be deployed in an air-gapped environment. Clients listed include browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox and Edge, mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, a CLI (via the separate go-passbolt-CLI tool), and a desktop app that is described as coming soon. The README itself gives little install detail and points to the server deployment under "Run it on your own server, natively".
use_cases: manage secrets in an air-gapped environment
how_to_run: See the README section 'Run it on your own server, natively' (no concrete commands given in the README)
notable: User-owned secret keys with end-to-end encryption
Audited multiple times per year with public findings
No personal data collection or telemetry, deployable air-gapped
Browser extensions for Chromium browsers, Firefox and Edge
caveats: Desktop app is only 'coming soon' with a pre-alpha version
README gives no concrete install commands; server setup is delegated to other docs
Trademark: the Passbolt name is not licensed for reuse under AGPL without a separate agreement
